milestones.title: Intensify coastal embankment monitoring during the November high tides
milestones.description: Amirudin reported heightened monitoring from Sabak Bernam through Kuala Selangor to Morib, alongside disaster preparedness and evacuation arrangements.
milestones.progress_note: In progress reflects the 6 November operational report. It does not certify that all embankments were strengthened or that later flooding was prevented. The tide forecast is not a project completion deadline.

milestones.title: Review development approvals and inspect projects after the Puncak Alam floods
milestones.description: Amirudin said the state would re-examine development approvals and investigate two projects around Saujana Aman following flash flooding.
milestones.progress_note: The review and investigations are announced steps. Their conclusions, remedial construction and resolution of the wider flood problem were not established.

milestones.title: Launch Projek Amal Rakyat fundraising for Ampang residents
milestones.description: Rodziah pledged a community fundraising initiative to sustain constituency assistance; an August interview documents its first asam pedas sales.
milestones.progress_note: Achieved is limited to launching the initiative. Early sales and orders do not prove collection of the RM300,000 sought, payment of all pending aid or restoration of constituency allocations.

methodology: Dated public commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. An evidence-only record has no invented earlier promise. Status is tied to its evidence snapshot and shared agency responsibility is explicit. Historical activity is not a live November performance measurement. Allocations, attendance, sales orders and unrelated programme ratios are not completion percentages. Additional research may extend this initial pass.
